tagline: Single field filter default: Changing the field on a single field filter now clears the previous field's default value.
what_it_does: Single field filter default: Changing the field on a single field filter now clears the previous field's default value. The filter falls back to All, or to None when All isn't allowed. Widget level filter refresh: The values in widget level filters now refresh when a dataset changes, without a browser refresh.
